name: Domain Content Type Access
project_description: Domain Content Type Access (det_node) is the default-enabled submodule of Domain Access Entity Type. It provides new allowed-domain checkboxes on the content type (node type) add/edit form to restrict a content type to selected domains (if no domain is selected the content type is accessible on all domains). It exposes the permission `bypass content type domain access check` to bypass the check for a role, and enforces the restriction on the content-type list, the add page, and node/node-type edit/delete/permissions routes. It requires the Domain module and the parent domain_entity_type module.
